steps.body: A square stays a square when it is turned. The picture shows the same four equal sides and four square corners in both positions.
steps.narration: A square stays a square when it is turned. The picture shows the same four equal sides and four square corners in both positions.

widget.prompt: All four are triangles. Tap the one that is still a triangle after being turned upside down.

hotspots.label: circle
hotspots.feedback: A circle is not a triangle at all — it has no straight sides.

hotspots.label: square
hotspots.feedback: A square has 4 sides, so turning it never makes it a triangle.

hotspots.label: rectangle
hotspots.feedback: A rectangle has 4 sides; turning changes nothing about that.

widget.missFeedback: Turning never changes sides or corners — look for the 3-sided shape.
widget.successFeedback: Yes — turning a triangle leaves all 3 sides and 3 corners exactly as they were.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g1s nondefining.
invariants: A shape's defining attributes must stay fixed while colour, size and orientation vary.
misconceptions: Treating colour, size or orientation as if it decided what a shape is.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same shape?

widget.prompt: Which of these can change WITHOUT a square stopping being a square?

options.label: Its color
options.feedback: Correct — color can change to anything and the shape is still a square.

options.label: Its number of sides
options.feedback: Change the number of sides and it stops being a square — that attribute defines it.

options.label: Its number of corners
options.feedback: Corners are a defining attribute; changing them changes what the shape is.

options.label: Whether its sides are straight
options.feedback: Straight sides are part of what a square is; curving them makes a different shape.

options.label: 4 straight sides and 4 square corners
options.feedback: Correct — a rectangle has 4 straight sides and 4 square corners; colour, size, and direction can change.

options.label: Painted a bright red colour
options.feedback: Color can change freely without the shape changing; it is not a defining attribute.
